why: THE decoding presets of OCR Lite (compiled into the app, read-only there) — the same presets an evaluation or a server-side read (vLLM, Transformers) uses, so a read in the browser and a scored read decode alike. A knob not listed here does not exist. Change a preset here, nowhere else.

fields.topP: nucleus cut, only with temperature > 0 (1.0 = off)
fields.repetitionPenalty: windowed: each distinct token among the last repetitionWindow tokens (prompt tail + output): logit < 0 → × rp, else ÷ rp (hf/window_rep_penalty.py); 1.0 = off
fields.repetitionWindow: tokens the repetition penalty looks back
fields.frequencyPenalty: logit −= value × count of the token in the OUTPUT so far (vLLM's frequency_penalty); 0 = off
fields.maxNewTokens: hard token limit of one read
fields.gtTokenCapFactor: scoring a page with a reference transcription: max tokens = max(gtTokenCapFloor, min(maxNewTokens, int(factor × the reference's tokens))), counted by the model's own tokenizer

names: letters, digits, . _ - only (a preset name is passed as one shell word)
seedRule: a sampled read (temperature > 0) uses seed = int(md5(page stem, UTF-8).hexdigest()[:8], 16) — the same page reads the same every time
